metaDescription: Balanced freshwater aquarium builds, consultations, and aquatic plant cuttings from Hot Mess Hobby Shop.
lead: My most obsessive hobby: freshwater tanks built to balance themselves. Plants and bioload in equilibrium, healthy fish, low-stress upkeep — just top off the water and let it run. Everything below comes out of that same philosophy: aquatic plant cuttings from tanks that actually work, real builds I've done, and a way to get your own tank into balance.

plants.heading: Aquatic Plants
plants.intro: Cuttings and cultures pulled straight from tanks that actually work — no algae, no pests, no shortcuts. Placeholder listings below — swap these out with real cuttings, photos, and prices whenever you're ready.

products.name: Java Fern
products.description: Hardy, low-light rhizome plant. Comes as an established portion ready to attach to hardscape.

products.name: Anubias Nana
products.description: Slow-growing, nearly indestructible. A staple for any balanced tank.

products.name: Floating Plant Mix
products.description: A mix of frogbit and salvinia — natural nutrient export and shade for shy fish.

gallery.heading: Tanks I've Built
gallery.intro: A few balanced ecosystems, in different sizes — each one basically runs itself.

requestForm.heading: Request a Consultation or Custom Build
requestForm.intro: Want help getting your tank into balance, or a full custom build? Custom builds are local pickup/delivery only. Tell me what you're working with and I'll follow up.
